### Borea v0.6.7

A patch release that lets you share a new version of a vehicle or save from its page. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### What's new

- The page of a vehicle or save that you shared now has "Share a new version".
- This also works when you shared the first version on another computer or on the site of the share host.
- Such a page asks "Did you share this?" and offers "Share a new version" there, and the share host checks that the listing is yours.
- The new version goes to the listing that you chose, and you then choose the vehicle or save for it.
- When the share host refuses the short name because a listing already uses it, you can choose "This is mine" and share the item as a new version of that listing.
- If the share host does not accept that claim, "Share it on its own instead" takes you back.

#### Good to know

- "Change the page" and "Take down a version" still show only for items that you shared from this computer.
- In Simplified Chinese, the new texts show in English until they are translated.

Full changelog: [v0.6.6...v0.6.7](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.6...v0.6.7)
